methodology.downloads: Hugging Face downloads show activity inside the Hub ecosystem. They are not unique users, revenue or global market share.
methodology.country: Country refers to the originating organization as classified by the cited source, not where inference runs. Distributed or unclear origins limit geographic attribution.
methodology.openWeights: Open-weight means model weights are downloadable. It does not by itself guarantee open training data, open code or unrestricted commercial use.
